prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Summary of key proposals (ideological framing removed)

Economy and business
- Responsible public finances (OBR oversight; Bank of England independence). Reverse tax cuts for big banks; one‑off windfall tax on oil/gas; raise Digital Services Tax to 6%; reform capital gains tax; 4% levy on FTSE‑100 share buybacks. Priority for future tax cuts: raise personal allowance.
- Industrial strategy focused on green growth; expand British Business Bank; nationwide gigabit broadband; financial inclusion duty for FCA/PRA.
- Abolish business rates, replace with a Commercial Landowner Levy; prompt‑payment enforcement; AI regulatory framework; stronger Parliamentary role on trade deals; R&D to 3% of GDP by 2030 (3.5% by 2034); rejoin Horizon Europe/EIC.

Climate and energy
- Net zero by 2045; 90% of electricity from renewables by 2030; ban fracking and new coal mines; expand tidal/wave; more interconnectors and storage.
- Ten‑year home upgrade (free insulation/heat pumps for low‑income households); zero‑carbon standard for new buildings; landlords to EPC C by 2028; social tariff; decouple electricity prices from gas.
- Net Zero Delivery Authority; citizens’ assemblies; carbon border adjustment; company net‑zero plans; align UK ETS with EU ETS.

Health and care
- Right to see a GP within seven days (24 hours urgent); recruit 8,000 GPs; expand roles for pharmacists/nurses; universal 24/7 booking.
- Dentistry: reform contract; emergency access; supervised toothbrushing; remove VAT on children’s dental hygiene products.
- Mental health: youth walk‑in hubs; regular check‑ups; specialist in every school; end out‑of‑area placements; extend youth services to 25.
- Cancer: 62‑day treatment guarantee; more radiotherapy machines/nurses; faster approvals.
- Public health: stronger grant; ban single‑use vapes; tobacco profits levy; Clean Air Act.
- Social care: free personal care; workforce plan; Royal College of Care Workers; Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/h); paid carer’s leave; statutory respite; National Care Agency.

Education and families
- Per‑pupil funding above inflation; repair/replace buildings; “Tutoring Guarantee” for disadvantaged pupils.
- Mental health professional in every school (funded by higher Digital Services Tax).
- Early years: +5 free hours for disadvantaged 3–4‑year‑olds; triple Early Years Pupil Premium.
- Lifelong Skills Grants (£5,000 per adult, aim £10,000).
- Teacher workforce strategy; independent pay review; paid trainee posts; curriculum/qualification reform.
- Parental leave/pay: day‑one rights incl. self‑employed; maternity/shared parental pay doubled to £350/week; paternity pay at 90% (capped); extra month for partners; “Toddler Top‑Up”; paid neonatal leave.
- Expand Erasmus+ participation.

Welfare and pensions
- Scrap two‑child limit and benefit cap; cut UC wait to five days; replace sanctions with incentives; protect triple lock; fair compensation for 1950s‑born women; increase and widen Carer’s Allowance.

Crime and justice
- Restore community policing; guarantee attendance/investigation of all burglaries.
- New Online Crime Agency; resource NCA; replace PCCs with local Police Boards.
- Halve time from offence to sentencing; workforce strategy for courts; free transcripts for victims.
- Public‑health approach to youth violence; statutory youth diversion; fraud victim reimbursement.
- Domestic abuse specialists in control rooms; 1‑hour police‑to‑health handover target.
- Prisons: end overcrowding; more officers; education/work in custody; National Resettlement Plan.

Environment, food and farming
- Water: convert companies to public‑benefit model; ban bonuses until spills/leaks end; replace Ofwat; Sewage Tax; real‑time discharge data; social tariff.
- Double nature by 2050; 60m trees/year; protect 30% of land/sea by 2030; Environmental Rights Act; Clean Air Act with new agency.
- National Food Strategy; accelerate ELMS (+£1bn/yr); veterinary/plant health deals with EU; strengthen Groceries Code Adjudicator; Animal Welfare Bill; ban caged hens; clear food labelling.

Housing and local government
- Build 380,000 homes/year (150,000 social); ten new garden cities; enable councils to buy land at current‑use value; “use‑it‑or‑lose‑it” permissions; brownfield with affordable quotas.
- Renters: ban no‑fault evictions; default three‑year tenancies; national landlord register.
- Abolish residential leasehold; cap ground rents; remove cladding costs from leaseholders.
- End rough sleeping; repeal Vagrancy Act. Local powers on second homes/short‑lets.
- Multi‑year council settlements; gigabit to all premises; rural fuel duty relief.

Transport
- EV push: more chargers; restore plug‑in grant; 2030 ZEV mandate; cut VAT on public charging to 5%; card access; grid upgrades.
- Freeze rail fares; new Railway Agency; sanction failing operators; 10‑year electrification; Northern Powerhouse Rail; review HS2 north.
- Bus franchising and integrated funding; maintain £2 fare cap; zero‑emission buses.
- Active travel networks; more local road maintenance.
- Aviation: tax reform targeting frequent/private jet flyers; show flight vs rail emissions; ban short domestic flights where <2.5h rail exists; moratorium on net airport expansion.

Culture, media and sport
- Protect BBC/S4C/Channel 4; rejoin Creative Europe; creative enterprise zones; Anti‑SLAPP law; proceed with Leveson Part 2; gambling levy/ombudsman/affordability checks; independent football regulator.

Immigration and asylum
- End Hostile Environment; move work/student visa policy out of Home Office.
- Scrap Illegal Migration Act and Rwanda plan; uphold Refugee Convention; safe/legal routes; process most asylum claims within three months; allow work after three months.
- Replace salary threshold with sector‑based merit system; exemptions for NHS/care; expand Youth Mobility; reverse family visa income hikes; secure EU citizens’ status with physical proof.

Rights and political reform
- Uphold Human Rights Act; ban conversion practices; repeal recent anti‑protest laws; Digital Bill of Rights; regulate biometrics.
- Votes at 16; scrap voter ID; cap donations; PR (STV) for Commons and English councils; ministerial code in law; Lords reform; citizens’ assemblies; stronger transparency and lobbying rules; federal constitutional reform.

Defence and international
- Increase defence spending towards 2.5% of GDP; reverse Army cuts; maintain nuclear deterrent; tighter arms export controls; Parliamentary votes on military action.
- Restore 0.7% aid with independent department; multi‑stage plan to rebuild UK‑EU ties (including Single Market aim long‑term); support Ukraine (including seizing Russian assets); ceasefire and two‑state framework for Israel‑Palestine; recognise Palestine; sanctions for human‑rights abuses; fund BBC World Service.
